leadText: Rebecca Soler is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of . Starting with the sixteenth season, she is credited as Jessica Paquet. She is currently affiliated by Innovative Artists.
plainText:
Rebecca Soler is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of . Starting with the sixteenth season, she is credited as Jessica Paquet. She is currently affiliated by Innovative Artists.

==Biography==
Soler was born sometime on August 24 in New York City, New York, though she grew up in Boston, Massachusetts; and Sugar Land, Texas. She attended and graduated with a bachelor's degree in theater. Afterward, she began a voice-acting career. Soler has worked on the properties for 4Kids Entertainment, Central Park Media, Media Blasters, NYAV Post, and DuArt Film & Video. Her first few roles in were right before the Pokémon USA recasting controversy; during that time, she voiced Kidd Summers, Rhoda, and . Later on, after DuArt took over the dubbing from TAJ Productions, Soler returned to provide voices for the series, starting with Losing Its Lustrous!. In , she provided the voice of .

Soler departed from the series following Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon, with Emily Cramer taking on her role as Mallow. In 2020, Soler gave birth to a daughter.
